caption:
January: Review & Reflect

I invited myself and the Vision and Execution Series members to take a moment and review and reflect on January as it comes to a close.

This month has felt like the substance of six, anyone else? How is it only the end of Jan…

As a result of my internal preparation at the end of last year I made a few significant changes in my business with launching my first group offering (omg its been the best!!), shifting how I work with clients which lead to refining my consulting offerings and mapping this year out with clear intentions. I’ve already it major goals and milestones for the year ✨ this is no mistake or luck, it’s the cause and effect of taking intentional action and pursuing greater alignment. 

Here are a few reflection prompts to recalibrate as we head into February:
1. How did this month feel overall?
2. What did I accomplish and make progress on this month that is in alignment with my big vision?
3. What did I learn this month?
4. Where or what is feeling heavy or causing friction in my life and biz? How can I shift or let it go?
5. What is my intention for next month and what changes do I need to make to step in alignment with it?

It’s your business, your world, design it that way.

caption:
The past few weeks have felt really full. Work has been overflowing and summer has felt fleeting.

I caught myself living as though I still had to earn the freedom I’d built. 

Wasn’t this the whole reason I became an entrepreneur? To have freedom over my days... and how I spend them.

Then I became aware of the guilt. The guilt of taking the afternoon off. And somehow, the guilt of not tackling one more task.

It felt like I couldn’t win.

No one was asking me to stay and work. No one was going to give me time off. The pressure was coming from me.

I’ve always designed my business to create freedom.

But I’m realizing that learning how to use that freedom might be its own kind of work.

#founderlife #smallbusinessowner #entrepreneurlife #foundermindset

• The burger and french onion soup at Petite Boucherie in Greenwich is to die for (we went back twice in one day)

• We walked everywhere, explored different boroughs and jumped on the subway if we had a destination
• The department store window displays are wow! Shopping at Christmas in nyc is everything you think, festive and chaos!
• Rockefeller tree and rink is a must see but Bryant Park is much bigger, less crowded and had a cute holiday market
• We skated in Central Park, highly recommend for the scenery, size and price in comparison to the others
• @therockettes at Radio City was such a good show!
• Shopping in Soho is superior, also look up your favourite brands as they may be doing a nyc pop up or event

- Being realistic with what I’m available for and not, saying no more

- Prioritizing sleep so I have more energy
- Constantly auditing how each day felt, measuring it against the intention I set at the beginning of my day

caption:
If you’ve been around here for a while you most likely know that I founded a wellness tea company (in 2018!!) from my passion for the therapeutic benefits herbs offered. 

Throughout my many years of backpacking overseas I learned first hand the importance of tea in their cultures, ceremonies and economies. From this space I decided to bring this connection to my home in Canada. 

I began drinking black tea (with too much sugar and milk to really call it tea) with my Oma from a young age, evolving my palette into earl grey, herbal teas, greens and every other kind. It took me a while to fall in love with matcha, soon realizing not all matcha’s are created equally and it was a similar process to finding a wine you love. 

Matcha has many varietals depending on where it is grown and how it is harvested. One of the most significant differentiators between a high quality matcha that is packed with all the benefits and a poor quality is it being ceremonial grade. 

WHAT IS MATCHA?
Ceremonial Matcha is a fine green tea powder that has a smooth, earthy taste. It originates from China but is now mainly produced in Japan. It was originally used to sharpen the focus of meditation and is known as a symbol of harmony, respect and tranquility. The ritual of matcha is noted in the mindful preparation of the beverage (you won’t find a high quality matcha being prepared by the press of a button, ever.)

BENEFITS OF MATCHA
Matcha is packed with an abundance of antioxidants, vitamins, minerals and best known for it’s slow energy release (without the caffeine crash) from the amino acid, L-Theanine, which creates a calm sustained energy and sharp mind. 

There’s no better way to start your day with a matcha. Make it americano style or as a hot or iced latte. Check out my reel on how I make my morning matcha! 🍵

caption:
A flashback to my entrepreneur journey:

In 2016 I founded a fashion accessories brand, Lanniez. Creating street-inspired lanyards for your everyday sun/glasses. As the trend was taking over Europe and popping up on the runway I gained quick success from early adopters, grew internationally and began exploring overseas manufacturing to increase our capacity. After 2 years I was honest with myself in how revolving trends went against my values and decided to take my learnings and quietly closed. 

In 2018 I was reinspired to create something new and support the wellbeing of the community through the therapeutic benefits of herbs. Woash Wellness launched with an exclusive line of tea blends, a cult-fav mug and accessories. In the beginning I was living a double life of wellness enthusiast by day and server / partying by night. We proved our concept quick, cultivated a loyal community, collaborated with inspiring people, expanded into wholesale and grew internationally both in-store and online.

Simultaneously in 2019 from organic demand I began consulting for new entrepreneurs supporting them from ideation to market under Wyld Business Consulting. Which also encompassed The Wyld Method - a simplified guide of 10 steps to starting a business. In 2021 I followed my experience and interests niching into product creation, customer UX and growth strategy under Studio Memi. 

In 2023 with my interests and energy split and as I started a family I came to a cross road: do I double down and grow Woash or embrace I had given it my all and now it was time for someone else to take it where it deserves, freeing up space for what was next. In July 2023 I officially sold Woash!! (You can hear more about this on my pinned post and announcement video)

Ok we made it!! After a little time off with Romee I was approached to support another entrepreneur which has now evolved into this space you are currently in. A vessel I designed to encompass everything I have learned, utilize my skills and experience and hold all of my creative evolutions to come, in pursuit of my mission to guide entrepreneurs to their greatest potential through the energetics and fundamentals of business. 💙

How I reset and let go of anxious feelings:

1. Ask yourself what you need and want in this moment. Go and do that or schedule it in when you can. 
2. Set the intention to let go of anxious feelings, clear your mind and get into your body. 
3. Eliminate any stimulants (phone, caffeine, alcohol, music)
4. Move your body in a way that you enjoy and intentionally breath deep and slow
5. Focus on singular simple things to calm the mind
6. Write it all out and create a list of things you are grateful for
7. Look up and feel the magnitude of the world around you and the abundance of support you can tap into

caption:
It hit me the other day that I’m living the life I envisioned for my future self but it looks completely different than I imagined. 

The past year I switched gears in my personal development, I moved away from tools that helped me acknowledge and heal the past and into shifting in the present and creating my future self. 

Through this new practice I became very clear on who and what my future self felt like and taking tangible daily actions that brought her into reality. These past few weeks it hit me that I am living this life! Building a business that embodies my deepest why, helping my clients fulfill their true potential in business, travelling, prioritizing family time, feeling good and connected to my body, trying new experiences, spending intentional time with friends and family, taking space for just me and being incredibly grateful for each day. 

Feeling this also made me realize that it physically looks a lot different than I imagined. We aren’t in a big new house, or making the money I imagined, flying first class or living abroad etc. It’s funny how I almost bypassed this time because not all the materialism or bigger vision is present but a version of it is.

What I learned was how we can perpetuate this feeling of being stuck instead of realizing we can weave the things we most desire into our everyday today and live our future life right now. The more we do this the more it grows. 

The universe provides in interesting ways but take responsibility to look for it in your everyday. 🤍

How to make the perfect matcha latte:
1. Set your kettle to 176 F
2. Use 1 tsp of high quality matcha (a tell is how bright green it is!)
3. Pour approx 2 oz of hot water over the powder
4. Whisk rigorously in a W shape until the matcha foams with tiny bubbles
5. Optional: add a sweetener
6. Foam a high quality milk (I use oat)
7. Pour the milk over the matcha

Benefits of matcha:
- L-theanine (amino acid) stimulates the brain while calming the nervous system
- Stable, long lasting caffeine (no crash)
- High in antioxidants 
- Anti-inflammatory
- Naturally detoxifying
- Vitamin a, b, c, e, k

caption:
I’ve lost count of our unexpected trips to the hospital this past year. Definitely not how I envisioned 2023 playing out but here we are absorbing each lesson, looking for the silver lining and planning to do better. 

A little over a week ago we spent the night in the emerg as I experienced intense back pain and a fainting episode. Everything looking healthy and normal I feel I’ve simply hit a 6-month pp burnout and my body strongly suggested rest. 

This past weekend Sean was unexpectedly sent to the emerg after a series of tests with the suspicion he may have diabetes. Since breaking his leg shortly after Romee was born he has lost a significant amount of weight that everyone deemed was just due to his leg and not being as active. Now learning he had quick onset of diabetes that can’t really be explained other than it being ‘the perfect storm’ with his leg, limited activity and a sub-par diet these past few months. 

It breaks my heart to see his life and ours change so quickly. He doesn’t deserve it as does anybody who is diagnosed with anything. 

As we’ve taken a crash course in diabetes, food and our bodies with such conflicting protocols and solutions, which deserves a much bigger conversation we’ve landed on Karen Hurd’s Bean Protocol in hopes it can be managed through diet and lifestyle. 

All this to say we continue to deepen our learning of surrender, to lean on our family and friends and to not be afraid to continuously question how things are done. You can expect to see a bit more wellness and lots of non blood sugar spiking meals and recipes.

2024 we are ready for you! 🤍

hi! it’s been a while, some of you may be wondering how you ended up following this account or continued following to see what’s next! I’m Cassandra, former founder of @drinkwoash

In 2021 we had our biggest year and projected to continue our growth, 2022 we felt the ripple affect of the pandemic and my personal interests began focusing elsewhere. It took me over a year to officially decide to sell and pursue a different version of business, one that fully reflects who I am and has the foundation to evolve with me. The sale went through in July 2023 after a bit of negotiating I left feeling incredibly proud of what I had created and excited for its next evolution with the new owner.

With this new found space and a newborn at home I’ve felt inspired to reconnect with you through the many facets of my evolution. caption:
This is our birth story. I intuitively knew I wanted to have a home birth. Like many my husband raised some concerns so we asked a lot of questions, explored all options and gathered the best team to support us on this journey. He soon became my biggest advocate. 

As 36 weeks hit I anxiously awaited the big day, constantly reminding myself to trust my body and our baby as it knows exactly what to do. 

Four days before our due date my water released. I felt anxious and incredibly excited as we were soon going to find out the sex of our little babe! That evening we prepped our house for baby’s arrival and tried to rest. It wasn’t until early the next morning things were getting quite intense and I felt this uncontrollable urge to push during every surge. Our midwife arrived and said I had a long way to go, try to rest. Hours went by and we noticed their was a part of my cervix caught on her head which was preventing it from fully opening. We tried all sorts of positions and finally I asked what my options were as I felt completely depleted. My husband said let them check you one more time before we make any decisions. 

I was almost there but still a remainder was caught on her head, my doula suggested an inversion to allow gravity to lift her off and give room to fully open. It worked! This moment felt like I conquered Everest. During the pushing phase I continuously told myself, “this is only temporary” and “each surge was one less to meeting our little babe.” Two hours later (and pushing the 24 hour infection window) Romee Blue was here! 

We all collapsed on our bed, soaking up our sweet girl ready to stay nested at home for the coming weeks. To our surprise and completely against my home-birth plan we began to notice Romee’s oxygen was slightly low, taking our midwives recommendation we headed into the hospital to have her checked out. Within moments of me handing her over 4 nurses and 1 doctor had her hooked up to endless cords, an oxygen mask and running blood tests. I was devastated, angry and frustrated after all that we ended up here. In the hospital.
